business.description: Tirupati Finlease Limited is a Reserve Bank of India (RBI) registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) classified as an Investment Company (IC) under the applicable regulatory framework and categorised as a Base Layer NBFC under the Reserve Bank of India's Scale Based Regulation framework. The Company is engaged in investment activities and does not accept public deposits.
